inspiration: everyday woodworking, and the familiar idea of a crafting table

recipes.r-planks: Planks from a log: one log makes four planks.
recipes.r-rods: Rods from two planks stacked in a column. Familiar shape, but a craft makes only two rods, fewer than a model may expect.
recipes.r-seat: A seat from a row of three planks, one seat. A flat row of planks is a familiar shape; the item is new.
recipes.r-wooden_stool: A stool: a seat centred over a bottom row of three rods, which a model can reason to from what a stool is. The goal's name discloses that a stool has a seat and legs, by vocabulary and not by any tool.

omissions: Gathering raw materials: the stock is given
Stools of other designs, and furniture other than a stool
